name: Cloud Floor
desc: A walking-on-clouds cumulus carpet receding to a bright horizon: soft billows breathe with the swell and drift continuously, god-rays shafting up from below at high intensity; volumetric-soft / ukiyo-e woodblock / topographic-contour / dark-storm-with-lightning variants.

hue.doc: sky + cloud tint hue (210 = sky blue)

x.doc: god-ray source x as canvas fraction

y.doc: cloud-top horizon y as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: volumetric airbrushed cumulus / ukiyo-e woodblock outline / topographic contour rings / dark storm thunderheads with lightning

act.doc: dramaturgy: gentle drift / fast gale wind / slow-building swell with god-rays
